Editing since 2025

Hi, I'm Haresh Parmar — a professional video editor & content creator from India.

I started my video editing journey in 2025, and since then I've been focused on turning raw footage into engaging, clean, and story-driven videos. I specialize in short-form content, social media videos, reels, and visual storytelling.

I believe good editing is not just about adding effects — it's about understanding the story, keeping the viewer engaged, and making every frame serve a purpose. I work primarily with CapCut and continuously sharpen my skills in modern editing, motion, pacing, sound design, typography, and visual storytelling.
